architectural_risks.description: Same array shape Node 07 produces, additive to it (both flow into Node 13 unmodified). Open, evidence-driven set -- no fixed length. One object per distinct finding.

finding_id.description: GENERATED for this run: {CATEGORY-SLUG}-{NN}. NOT a stable cross-run key -- claim_id is.

risk_category.description: Exact enum value, with a space. Single best fit.

claim_id.description: STABLE identifier: literal function/variable/state-variable names verbatim from this finding's own evidence array, uppercased, sorted alphabetically, hyphen-joined, protocol-slug-prefixed. Never derived from risk_category, severity, or risk_name.

primary_component.description: Contract/module name copied verbatim from the source, not paraphrased.

mechanism_tokens.description: Literal function/variable names verbatim from the source. Same tokens claim_id is built from.

dependency_chain.description: Ordered causal chain, outermost call to root data source, if described. Empty array if not applicable.

severity.description: Normalized from the source's own rating -- see provenance.original_severity_label for the verbatim original.

evidence.description: Verbatim quotes from the source only. No paraphrasing.

governance_model.description: Almost always 'Unknown' unless the source explicitly states who controls the relevant role.

mitigation_considerations.description: From the source's own recommended-mitigation text only. Empty array if none.

confidence.description: Confidence in extraction faithfulness, not the finding's validity. High (0.85-1.0) for a clear primary-source finding; lower if reconstructed from a secondary summary or fields were implied rather than stated.

provenance.description: NEW field vs Node 07's schema. Exists for the dismissed-finding tracker to key off -- Node 13 ignores it.

source_url.description: Exact URL/file this was extracted from. Required.

date_flagged.description: ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) date the finding was ORIGINALLY raised -- not today, not parsing date.

original_severity_label.description: Exact severity label as it appears in the source, before normalization. Use "NOT_STATED" if none appears -- this schema has no nullable fields.

category.description: UNKNOWN unless the source itself explicitly states a resolution/status.

verbatim_quote.description: Exact quoted sentence establishing disposition, or "NOT_STATED" if category is UNKNOWN.

quote_location.description: e.g. 'sponsor comment', 'report status column'. "NOT_STATED" if verbatim_quote is "NOT_STATED".

extraction_confidence.description: VERIFIED_PRIMARY_QUOTE only if verbatim_quote is from this primary source document.
